text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab countries denounce Turkish invasion of northern Iraq.
- France renews call for withdrawal of Turkish troops from northern Iraq.
- Italy condemns Turkish invasion and calls for immediate withdrawal of troops.
- First ship loaded with sugar arrives at Umm Qasr on Saturday.
- Zionists preparing for demolition of more Arab houses in occupied territories.
- Tunisia pleased with level of bilateral trade with Iraq.
- Spanish and French delegations leave Iraq.
- Government slashes fees on building licences.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ)
- Article on measures needed to protect environment in Iraq.
- Editorial lambasts Turkish invasion of northern Iraq.
- Editorial says how treacherous Kurdish parties in northern Iraq have become.
